_note: Approved/limited_use snapshot only. Not the full research dataset. A phrase here is a candidate to consider when it fits the exact meaning, platform, audience and register of the copy you're writing — never insert it just because it's listed.

phrases.usage_guidance: Use as the primary head term for the JA font converter tool (title, H1, WebApplication schema alternateName). This is the term real users type into font-conversion sites per Chiebukuro answers that recommend 'フォント変換サイト'.
phrases.good_example: フォント変換 — かわいい・おしゃれな文字にコピペで変換（無料）
phrases.avoid_when: n/a — safe, mainstream, already the site's core term

phrases.usage_guidance: Use for the aesthetic/vaporwave-fullwidth style family, distinct from かわいい文字 (softer/cuter register). Natural, not stiff.
phrases.good_example: おしゃれ文字 変換 — ａｅｓｔｈｅｔｉｃ なSNS表示名・プロフをコピペ
phrases.avoid_when: avoid for kids'/cute contexts — オシャレ skews slightly more mature/fashion than かわいい

phrases.usage_guidance: Central kawaii-aesthetic term; pairs naturally with soft symbols (⋆ ˚ ✧ ᥫ᭡ ꒰꒱) per namae-kawaii page — this pairing matches native usage exactly.
phrases.good_example: 名前 かわいい ⋆｡˚ コピペで作る — ゲーム・SNS・インスタ・TikTok

phrases.usage_guidance: Primary head term for the symbol library. Confirmed as real search/answer vocabulary independent of the site.
This is the single strongest, deepest-rooted JA-native content opportunity on the site — kaomoji originated in Japan. Treat as a flagship cluster, not a footnote category.
phrases.good_example: 顔文字 一覧 — かわいい顔文字コピペ（シンプル・泣く・嬉しい）

phrases.content_surface: used across nearly every ja/ page title/meta
phrases.usage_guidance: Never use the fuller 'コピー＆ペースト' in headlines — コピペ is the natural clipped form and is what the site already uses correctly throughout.
phrases.avoid_when: in formal/legal copy (privacy policy etc.) — use 'コピー' there instead

phrases.usage_guidance: Standard, correct JA term for 'cursive' in a typography context (as opposed to 'カーシブ' katakana loanword, which the page correctly offers only as a parenthetical gloss, not the primary term).
phrases.good_example: 筆記体変換 — 英語を筆記体（𝒞𝓊𝓇𝓈𝒾𝓋𝑒）にコピペで変換

phrases.usage_guidance: This is THE central Japan-specific pain point flagged in prior research, and it is well-covered as an FAQ answer across many pages — but there is NO dedicated /ja/answers/ page targeting '文字化け' as its own zero-click query the way namae-shikaku-hyouji-riyuu covers the boxes/? symptom. Treat 文字化け and 豆腐/四角表示 (JA-009) as the same underlying phenomenon described from two angles (technical cause vs. visual symptom) and consider whether they need a unified answer page.
phrases.good_example: 基本的にはありません。ただし一部の凝った顔文字は、古い端末やフォントによってわずかに見た目が変わることがあります。

phrases.usage_guidance: Correctly used and explained parenthetically ('豆腐（tofu）と呼ばれる現象') rather than assumed-known — good practice since this is community jargon, not universal vocabulary. Keep introducing it this way rather than using it unglossed.
phrases.good_example: これは豆腐（tofu）と呼ばれる現象で、決めているのは相手側の端末であってあなたの端末ではありません
phrases.avoid_when: in a headline/title — keep it in-body as an explainer term, matches current usage

phrases.usage_guidance: Well-built page mapping the exact real-world confusion (decorated font rejected in @handle field) to the fix (use display name instead). Matches the Instagram Unicode-input-app thread finding almost exactly.
phrases.good_example: ＠ユーザー名 = プレーンASCII（フォントを拒否）。表示名・bio = 装飾Unicode（受け付ける）。

phrases.usage_guidance: Strong, well-evidenced page. Demand for this trick is not game-specific — it spans Discord, LINE, and PazuDora (パズドラ) per new forum evidence, wider than the page currently frames it.
phrases.good_example: ふつうにスペースキーを押しただけでは、ほぼ必ずトリムされて消えてしまい…

phrases.usage_guidance: Correct and specific; matches exactly what the top Chiebukuro answer for the equivalent LINE query recommends (the same U+3164 character, just called '「ㅤ」' without the codepoint name in casual answers). Keep pairing the codepoint with the visual glyph as the page does.
phrases.good_example: もっとも信頼できるのはハングルフィラー（U+3164）です。

phrases.usage_guidance: Good, correctly-placed stakes framing ('リネームはリアルマネーがかかることが多いので、まずテストしましょう') — mirrors the real economic anxiety in Chiebukuro's own item-purchase answer ('ショップで名前変更アイテムを買うだけです').
phrases.good_example: リネームカードを無駄にしないためには？

phrases.usage_guidance: Well-executed, historically accurate page (correctly frames it as a 2002-2005 phenomenon with no single 'correct' ruleset, and correctly declines to support kanji-decomposition tricks like 神→ネ申 due to inconsistent rules) — good editorial honesty rather than overclaiming completeness.
phrases.good_example: 2002〜2003年ごろに登場した、日本の女子中高生を中心に流行した文字装飾です。

phrases.usage_guidance: Correctly used for Roblox's actual in-app error framing ('対応していない文字'). Distinct register from the more community-slang '対応不可' (JA-014) used specifically by 荒野行動 players — both are natural but belong to different platforms' own vocabulary, keep them separate rather than treating as interchangeable.
phrases.good_example: Robloxは表示名もユーザー名と同じチェックにかけ、ほとんどの装飾されたUnicode文字を「対応していない文字」として拒否します。
